description: Acknowledgement to an international student that a change of circumstance reportable to UKVI has been opened against their record. Sponsors must report most changes within 10 working days.
subject: Change of circumstance recorded — $change_type
body:
Dear $first_name,

We have opened a Change of Circumstance record against your sponsorship file. Under our duties as a Student Route sponsor we may need to report this change to UKVI within 10 working days.

Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Student ID:        $student_id
Change type:       $change_type
Occurred on:       $occurred_on
UKVI report due:   $ukvi_report_due
Details:           $details
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What happens next:
• The International Office will review the record and, where required, submit the report to UKVI before the date above.
• If the change was logged in error or the details are wrong, contact us immediately so we can correct the record.
• A reportable change may affect your immigration status (for example, withdrawal or suspension typically results in your visa being curtailed). If you are unsure how this affects your right to remain in the UK, please book a 1:1 with the International Office.

Kind regards,
University International Office

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
